shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' | head -100 && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!vendor'"' | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- page ---\\n' && cat app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- db ---\\n' && cat lib/db.js"
/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/app/AGENTS.md /workspace/lib/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '"'\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc "cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && cat app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- git ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && ls -la"
/bin/bash -lc 'find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print'
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && rg -n \"function revalidateTag|declare function revalidateTag|function unstable_cache|declare function unstable_cache\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git diff -- package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts && cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.d.ts && rg -n \"revalidateTag\\('.*max|revalidateTag\\(.*'max'|stale.while.revalidate\" node_modules/next/dist/docs -g '*.md*' | head -45"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start'

/bin/bash -lc 'action_name=$(python3 - <<'"'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class Parser(HTMLParser):
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'input' and attrs.get('name', '').startswith('"'$ACTION_ID_'"'):
            print(attrs['name'])
Parser().feed(open('/tmp/catalog-page.html').read())
PY
)
curl -sS -o /tmp/catalog-action.html -w 'Form POST: HTTP %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\\n' -F \""'$action_name=" http://localhost:3000/
curl -sS -o /tmp/catalog-after.html -w '"'Next catalog read: HTTP %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\\n' http://localhost:3000/
python3 - <<'PY'
page = open('/tmp/catalog-after.html').read()
print('Catalog still rendered:', 'Laptop' in page and '"'$999.00'"' in page)
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json && git diff --stat'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"isStale|pendingRevalidates|incrementalCache.get\\(\" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.js | head -60 && sed -n '100,235p' node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/unstable-cache.js"

/bin/bash -lc 'test_dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/catalog-check.XXXXXX)
cp -r app lib next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json "$test_dir/"
ln -s /workspace/node_modules "$test_dir/node_modules"
printf '"'%s' \""'$test_dir" > /tmp/catalog-check-dir
cat > "$test_dir/lib/db.js" <<'"'EOF'
import { readFile, appendFile } from 'node:fs/promises'

export async function getAllProducts() {
  await appendFile('/tmp/catalog-check-queries', 'query\\n')
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))
  const name = await readFile('/tmp/catalog-check-name', 'utf8')
  return [{ id: 1, name, price: 999 }]
}
EOF
printf 'Before sync' > /tmp/catalog-check-name
: > /tmp/catalog-check-queries
cd \""'$test_dir"
npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc 'test_dir=$(cat /tmp/catalog-check-dir)
rm "$test_dir/node_modules"
cp -al node_modules "$test_dir/node_modules"
cp package-lock.json "$test_dir/"
cd "$test_dir"
npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc 'test_dir=$(cat /tmp/catalog-check-dir)
cd "$test_dir"
npm run start -- --port 3001'
